dedupe_keys.name: remix eur data collection for sector integrated european energy system modelling

description: REMix-Eur is an open data collection for modelling the sector-integrated European energy system in high spatial, temporal and technological detail. It was published on Zenodo in July 2026 by Jens Schmugge, Hedda Gardian, Johannes Schaffert, Lukas Heidbreder, Enado Pineti, Nils Brede, Leander Kimmer, Yvonne Scholz and Hans Christian Gils of the German Aerospace Center (DLR), mainly within the Fahrplan Gaswende project funded by the German economy ministry, and is described in a paper in Advances in Applied Energy. It covers more than 100 technologies across 70 European regions mapped to NUTS areas, with techno-economic data on technology and commodity costs, and capacity boundaries such as demand, import, installed and installable capacities as profiles and annual sums. Demand is given for three future scenarios focused on electrification, hydrogen or synthetic fuels, including hourly heat and heat pump profiles, and electricity and gas network capacities are aggregated to the same regions. Metadata follow the Open Energy Metadata schema with detailed source notes, and configuration files are included where open-source software created the data. Coverage is Europe. Files are CSV and YAML, about 4.2 GB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: some source files carry their own licences. Simulation uses are European capacity expansion and sector-coupling studies with REMix or other models. Related records: data-powger-germany-remix-power-system uses the REMix framework.
